dcterms:description: The VisDial v1.0 dataset consists of images paired with dialog histories containing question-answer pairs. Each image has a dialog composed of 10 question-answer pairs along with a caption, and for each question-answer pair, 100 candidate answers are provided.
dcterms:title: VisDial v1.0

dcterms:description: The Audio Visual Scene-aware Dialog (AVSD) dataset requires a system to generate an answer to a question about events seen in a video given with a previous dialog. It includes audio features and video features.
dcterms:title: Audio Visual Scene-aware Dialog Dataset
